title: Taiwanese Student Association at University of Washington
content_html:
The Taiwanese Student Association at the University of Washington (TSAUW), also known by its Chinese name 華盛頓大學台灣學生會, is a registered student organization dedicated to improving Taiwanese cultural awareness on campus and in the Greater Seattle area. The organization’s website and UW career center listing both confirm it is open to students of all backgrounds — not just those of Taiwanese heritage — and that its programming spans both cultural and social events throughout the academic year.

TSAUW is best known as the organizer of the annual UW Night Market, which it has hosted since 2001, when it established what has since become one of the university’s most prominent student-run events. The Night Market is planned by a team of nearly 50 officers and draws community members from across the Seattle area. TSAUW also hosts smaller recurring events such as game nights and a winter semi-formal co-hosted with other Asian student organizations on campus.
